name: CSV Sales Summary CLI
description: A command-line tool that parses sales CSV files containing product name, quantity, and unit price, validates data integrity, computes per-product and total revenues, handles malformed/empty files gracefully, and outputs formatted sales summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Read a CSV containing product name, quantity, and unit price columns.
Validate required columns and numeric inputs (quantity >= 0, unit_price >= 0.0).
Compute per-product revenue (quantity * unit_price) and total revenue correctly.
Handle an empty CSV file cleanly without unhandled exceptions.
Handle malformed rows without silently inventing data.
Provide a usable command-line entry point executable via main.py.
Include automated behavioral tests for normal and failure cases.
